notes: No interrogative morpheme stands in the clause, so the fronted *Hast* is the verb's own under rule 17's first limit.

The supplied *its* is `added` under rule 18's closing sentence, no suffix or other possessive morpheme being present; the competing reading would fold it into `אֶרֶץ` as a resumed referent under rule 25, but rule 43's `מְרוֹחַ אָשֶׁךְ` precedent leaves such a supplied possessive `added`.

MACULA's glosses on `כֻלָּהּ` are distributed in reverse (*of.it* on `כֹּל`, *all* on the suffix); the surface and morphology were read instead, giving *all* to `כֹּל` and *it* to the suffix (rule 39).
